For my ozonated zeolite, I mix the powder into water and use an ozone-water purifier in a glass vessel because ozone destroys plastic. I mean ozonating water, never inhaling ozone gas.
With a machine producing about two grams of ozone per hour, ten minutes produced a working zeolite for me.

I also keep zeolite away from metal during preparation, so I use glass for ozonation and storage whenever possible. Zeolite adsorbs metals (they stick to it), which is part of why it is used for heavy-metal removal, and I don't want it sitting against a metal vessel or utensil before I swallow it.
